text:
Ari: Quick thread — proposing concrete SLOs for KV cache observability + GPU-pool saturation reporting. Our current dashboards show overall cache hit but not: per-region/ pool burn, or how cache misses contribute to latency SLOs. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Devon: +1. We need SLIs and a measurement recipe. Draft: 
- KV cache SLI = sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_lookups_total[5m])) 
- Expose by (region, gpu_pool, model_family) so we can attribute. 
- Error budget window: rolling 28d for product teams, but 7d for infra experiments.

Maria: For latency SLOs, do we count cold-starts as breaches? I think exclude known warmups: only count requests with kv_lookup_duration_ms < 200 to avoid double penalizing. Also p95 for interactive, p99 for batch.

Lee: Example PromQL for per-pool KV hit rate (w/labeling):
```
sum by (region, gpu_pool) (rate(kv_cache_hits_total{env="prod"}[5m]))
/
sum by (region, gpu_pool) (rate(kv_cache_lookups_total{env="prod"}[5m]))
```
And alert rule skeleton:
```yaml
alert: KVCacheBurningErrorBudget
expr: (1 - (sum by (region, gpu_pool) (rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) / sum by (region, gpu_pool) (rate(kv_cache_lookups_total[5m])))) > 0.10
for: 30m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "High KV miss rate in {{ $labels.region }}/{{ $labels.gpu_pool }}"
```

Ari: Also: how do we surface error budget burn (tokens/ $) to product? Suggest a derived metric: tokens_extra_generated_due_to_miss = sum(rate(kv_cache_lookups_total[5m]) * avg_tokens_per_request * (1 - hit_rate)). We can show cost in USD per day on dashboard.

Devon: Nice. For burn-rate alerts: we should compute burn as fraction of budget per 72h window and page when projected burn > 50% in 7d. PromQL sketch:
```
error_budget_burn_rate = increase(slo_breach_count_total[3d]) / (error_budget_points_in_window)
```
(we'll refine with SLI -> SLO conversions).

Maria: We also need a deterministic way to exclude maintenance events and deployment migrations from SLI. Propose a label `slo_exempt=true` emitted by deploy job during controlled drains. Then dashboards filter those out.

Lee: Will add Grafana panel templates: 1) rolling-window burn rate (28d), 2) per-region pool SLI heatmap, 3) projected budget runway widget, 4) cost impact column. Also include a click-to-open runbook.

srebot: [weekly-report] Generated error-budget report for prod: total error budget 1000 points, used 240 (24%) in last 28d. Top contributors: us-west-2-gpu-small (45%), eu-west-1-gpu-large (25%). Report URL: https://grafana.internal/reports/1802456789

Ari: Good signal from the bot. For paging rules: page when 1) budget burned > 30% in last 72h, OR 2) p99 latency SLO breached for >15m in >1 region. Otherwise slack alert to #eng-sre with context.

Devon: I'll open a PR with: PromQL alerts, grafana dashboard JSON (templated), and examples of synthetic tests that generate kv hits/misses to validate metrics. Will also include unit tests for label grouping.

Maria: Add a simulation job that runs once per day and emits expected SLO metrics to a staging timeseries so we can validate alerts pipeline.

Lee: Add a column to the SLO dashboard showing "estimated $/day impact" and link to cost playbook. Product likes dollar numbers.

Ari: Thanks — please tag me @Ari on the PR. Once merged we'll run a 2-week shadow run before we change paging thresholds. :thumbsup:

Devon: Will do, creating PR now.

Maria: Happy to review tests.

Lee: I'll wire up the runbook link and add the grafana annotations for deploy windows.

Ari: Reviewing now. If everyone agrees on metrics and exemptions, we can ship the dashboards Friday and start the shadow run Monday.
